name: Ride to Thunder Bluff
label: Quest
description: This quest sends young Horde adventurers taking their first flight path across Kalimdor aboard a wind rider. Entrusted with a shipment of cured hides…
intro: This quest sends young Horde adventurers taking their first flight path across Kalimdor aboard a wind rider. Entrusted with a shipment of cured hides, travelers depart the dry crossroads of the Barrens to deliver valuable leatherwork supplies directly to the heights of Thunder Bluff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff. There's no faster way to the city!
If that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go.
If you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff. And that's right where you'll land!

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is dust on your shoulders that must be from the Barrens. You have spoken with my friend Jahan?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, a new bundle of hides. I will get to work on these immediately!
Thank you, brother. You have done me a great service. Here are some coins to pay for your time and travel costs.
